name: Zagreb
tagline: Croatia's café-loving capital with a quirky streak
summary: Zagreb is a walkable Central European capital of Austro-Hungarian squares, a hilltop Upper Town with a tiled-roof church, lively markets and cafés. Its famous Advent market is one of Europe's best, and Plitvice Lakes is a day trip away.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are pleasant. December brings award-winning Advent markets. Summer is warm and quieter.
arrival: Zagreb Airport is 25 minutes by bus. Trains and buses link Ljubljana, Vienna and Budapest.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; trams cover the city.
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted; carry euro cash for ferries, markets and small konobas.
foodTip: Štrukli cheese pastry, ćevapi and kremšnita custard cake.
buyTip: Licitar hearts, neckties (the cravat is Croatian) and local brandies.
baseArea: Lower Town near Ban Jelačić Square
